sections.text:
Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Decreases the stats of all enemies by 30% for 60 seconds.
Stat decreasing effect boosted by 5% for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes buffs from all enemies.
-Decreases the Unison gauge of all enemies by 20.
-Reduces the Unison gauge gains of all enemies by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Removes resurrection from all enemies.
-Increases the Ability Power of all allies’ wind Unison damage by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Casts resurrection on your character.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000

[Additional Unison Effect] Casts Frenzy (nullifies debuffs and status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking) on all allied Archers and Rooks for 60 seconds.

Mortal Sin of Pride Supervia or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
